instrument_type_details.notes: No fuel hedging program. Fuel cost is primarily pass-through under capacity purchase agreements with major airline partners (United, Delta, American, Alaska and others). SKYW bears fuel risk only on pro-rate operations.

warnings: Fuel cost is primarily pass-through to major airline partners under capacity purchase agreements. United bears fuel risk for United Express; Delta bears fuel risk for Delta Connection RJ flights. Turboprop routes bear some fuel risk. No hedging program.

throughput.source_quote: Estimated: fuel expense $590,776K / $2.05 per gallon = ~288.2M gallons (includes Atlantic Southeast Airlines acquired 2005). Item 7: 'average price of fuel increasing to $2.05 per gallon during the year ended December 31, 2005.'
